ALPHA GUIDE 
Page 73 of 76 
 
TAKE ANOTHER STEP 
 
   Let’s connect 
  Would you like to stay up-to-date on all God is doing through Alpha in  
  transforming lives, communities and churches? Join our mailing list and  
  share your Alpha experience. You can also find other ways to get involved at: 
   
   alphausa.org/connect (USA)  
   alphacanada.org/connect (Canada)        
  caribbean.alpha.org (Caribbean) 
 
 
Tell us your story 
Has your life been changed through Alpha? We would love to hear how God 
worked in your life. It might be just what someone considering Alpha needs to 
hear to take that next step.   
 
   alphausa.org/mystory (USA)  
   office@alphacanada.org (Canada)  
   americas@alpha.org (Caribbean) 
 
Go deeper in the Word 
Looking to strengthen your faith journey? Subscribe to Nicky & Pippa 
Gumbel’s “Bible in One Year Plan.” Receive a daily email devotional that 
coordinates with the Bible in One Year Reading Plan.  
 
   alpha.org/bioy
